The 3-Step Proof-to-Pay Standard.

Replacing ambiguous PDF contracts and 90-day invoices with deterministic milestone states enforced by smart contracts.

01

Publish & Discover

Brands list structured deliverables, audience parameters, timeline boundaries, and verified budgets. Verified creators apply with authentic, audited media kits.

inventory_2 Granular Scope Schema

Campaign USDC deposits straight into immutable Polygon smart vaults. Neither Sponsify nor brands can unilaterally revoke locked milestone allocations.
